title: Gromov-Wasserstein at Scale, Beyond Squared Norms
tldr_zh: CNT 代价下 GW 分解为 lifted 线性对齐 + 平方欧氏 OT，线性内存、二次时间、可微、可探索能量景观
tldr_en: CNT-cost GW reduces to lifted linear alignment plus squared-Euclidean OT, enabling linear memory, quadratic time, differentiable solvers

key_numbers.number: O(N+M) memory, O(NM) time for CNT-GW iterations
MSGW 355s on FAUST 177k points, GW objective 1.4e-2
MSGW 196s on VESSELS 100k points, GW objective 7.4e-3
MSGW 83s on KIDS 60k points, GW objective 2.0e-2
MSGW one to two orders of magnitude faster than competitors
25 local minima from 500 random initializations; 8 best attract 82% of seeds
default epsilon=1e-3, embedding dim D=E=20 explaining 80-90% kernel variance
SGW_e >= 0 for CNT costs; SGW_e = 0 if isometric, converse false
